title: onboardingSystem document (flat node list)
description: A widget document as a flat list of nodes. Exactly one node has no parent (the root). Convert it to the tree with flatToTree, compile the Blueprint, and repair from its diagnostics.

nodes.description: Every widget of the document, parents before their children.

id.description: Unique within the document. Other nodes name it in "parent".

parent.description: The id of the parent node. Leave the key out on the one root node.

slot.description: The parent's slot this node goes into. Leave the key out on the root node. Children of one slot keep the order they have in "nodes". A Onboarding may go into: Onboarding.steps.

config.description: The wizard title per language and, optionally, the index of the step it opens on.

slots.description: Only needed to declare a slot that has no children; otherwise leave the key out. The slot names of this node, in order.

node_Onboarding.description: The root of the onboarding wizard. State: `current` (the index of the current step) and `finished`. Properties: `title`, `steps` (each step's title, `complete` and `missing`), `progress` and `answers`. Methods: `canEnter(index)` (read-only), `next()`, `back()`, `goTo(index)` (each writes `current` and emits `stepChanged`) and `finish()` (emits `completed`). A refused move is a Method diagnostic and changes nothing. Slots: steps: The steps in order: AccountStep, InterestsStep, SafetyStep or InductionStep. At least one.

id.description: Unique within the document. Other nodes name it in "parent".

parent.description: The id of the parent node. Leave the key out on the one root node.

slot.description: The parent's slot this node goes into. Leave the key out on the root node. Children of one slot keep the order they have in "nodes". A AccountStep may go into: Onboarding.steps.

config.description: The step title per language and, optionally, the name and e-mail address filled in at the start.

node_AccountStep.description: Step 1 of the onboarding wizard: the visitor's name and e-mail address (State `name` and `email`, filled in as they type). Properties: `title`, `missing` (`name` and/or `email` while they are empty or not an address), `complete` and `answers`. No slots: it cannot be a parent.

id.description: Unique within the document. Other nodes name it in "parent".

parent.description: The id of the parent node. Leave the key out on the one root node.

slot.description: The parent's slot this node goes into. Leave the key out on the root node. Children of one slot keep the order they have in "nodes". A InterestsStep may go into: Onboarding.steps.

config.description: The step title, the options (an id and a label per language), how many must be picked and which are picked at the start.

node_InterestsStep.description: Step 2 of the onboarding wizard: the interests the new member picks from the configured options (State `selected`: the picked ids). Properties: `title`, `options`, `missing` (`interests:<n>` while `n` more must be picked to reach `minimum`), `complete` and `answers` (the picked ids). No slots: it cannot be a parent.

id.description: Unique within the document. Other nodes name it in "parent".

parent.description: The id of the parent node. Leave the key out on the one root node.

slot.description: The parent's slot this node goes into. Leave the key out on the root node. Children of one slot keep the order they have in "nodes". A SafetyStep may go into: Onboarding.steps.

config.description: The step title, the safety rules (an id and a text per language) and which are acknowledged at the start.

node_SafetyStep.description: Step 3 of the onboarding wizard: the safety briefing. The visitor acknowledges each configured rule (State `acknowledged`: the ids acknowledged so far). Properties: `title`, `rules`, `missing` (one `rule:<id>` per rule not yet acknowledged), `complete` and `answers` (the acknowledged ids). No slots: it cannot be a parent.

id.description: Unique within the document. Other nodes name it in "parent".

parent.description: The id of the parent node. Leave the key out on the one root node.

slot.description: The parent's slot this node goes into. Leave the key out on the root node. Children of one slot keep the order they have in "nodes". A InductionStep may go into: Onboarding.steps.

config.description: The step title and the days and start times offered. Whether the booking office still has room is not known here: the host asks it.

node_InductionStep.description: Step 4 of the onboarding wizard: booking an induction slot, with the work kept at the host. Methods: `requestSlot(date, time)` (validated against the config; writes the request into State and emits `slotRequested` with a ticket), `settleBooking(ticket, outcome)` (the host's answer; applied only if the ticket is still the newest, otherwise ignored) and `cancelBooking()` (emits `slotCancelled`); `requestSlot` and `cancelBooking` are refused once the wizard is finished. Events: `slotRequested`, `slotConfirmed`, `slotDeclined`, `slotCancelled`. State: `status`, `ticket`, `slot`, `reference`, `reason`. No slots: it cannot be a parent.

name.description: Optional: leave the key out when unused.

email.description: Optional: leave the key out when unused.

prefill.description: Optional: leave the key out when unused.

type_I18nText.description: Text per language, `{ "en": "...", "zh-TW": "..." }`. `en` is required; a missing language falls back to it.

days.description: The days an induction can be booked, `YYYY-MM-DD`.

times.description: The start times offered on each day, `HH:MM`.

minimum.description: How many interests the visitor must pick (default 1). Optional: leave the key out when unused.

preselected.description: The ids picked at the start. Optional: leave the key out when unused.

startStep.description: The index of the step the wizard opens on (0 = the first). Optional: leave the key out when unused.

acknowledged.description: The ids of the rules acknowledged at the start. Optional: leave the key out when unused.
